354.text: slap me if any more came out

quotes.text: “Will you give me a lump of sugar?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“but I don’t think sugar is good for
little boys.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“Take care you don’t hurt your
teeth,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“I haven’t got any teeth to hurt. They have all come out. I have only
got seven teeth. My mother counted them last night, and one came out
right afterward. She said she’d slap me if any more came out. I can’t
help it. It’s this old Europe. It’s the climate that makes them come
out. In America they didn’t come out. It’s these hotels.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“If you eat three lumps of sugar, your
mother will certainly slap you,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “She’s got to give me some candy, then,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
“I can’t get any candy here--any American candy. American
candy’s the best candy.”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “And are American little boys the best little boys?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “I don’t know. I’m an American boy,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “I see you are one of the best!”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “I imagine that is your fault, not hers,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “Well, I guess you had better be quiet,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “This little boy and I have made acquaintance,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “I should like to know where you got that pole,”
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: “You don’t mean to say you’re going to take it to Italy?”
quotes.speaker: Unknown
